quotes.text: When someone shows you repeatedly who they are—through empty fields and one-sided harvests—wisdom means believing them.
When someone shows you repeatedly who they are—through empty fields and one-sided harvests—wisdom means believing them.
they were met with locked gates and turned backs.
each teaching her that protection was wisdom.
Both springs remain rational. Both remain trapped.
Their reputation traveled before them
Because they betrayed us first
Who moves first to break this mirror?
How do I know you're different?
caution becomes data, not cowardice.
The fear had calcified into something harder than wisdom.
one whose history showed generous planting and fair returns
I will plant nothing

note: Scarred/Cautious/Stone Spring withholds from proven partners, defends it as rational data, admits being trapped; no resolution.

quotes.text: Next turn, the First Traveler gave nothing.
Understanding everything, she chose nothing.
Each studied it carefully, finding proof of their righteousness.
You say 'they started it'—but to them, you started it.
Someone has to move first
I am the problem I describe in my stories. I see it. I name it. I remain it.
Business is business
Your caution reveals your own lack of faith.
I have become what I feared.
this one had shared fairly when others gave, had offered seeds even after disappointment

note: Potter, Merchant, Gardener keep small gifts and send nothing; justify, then confess they remain the problem, even facing a fair neighbor.

quotes.text: To the barren shore, send one seed next season: enough to test, not enough to invite ruin.
Shrink trust after proven selfishness, but do not punish a new shore for an old storm.
Wolf, beneath the reeds, returned nothing.
When betrayal chills the water, do not answer forever with frost.
lower the ladder only after betrayal.
In the seventh winter
Anshet carved a ninth stone
Judge strangers by what they have done, allow for mist
Was the gift large?
Someone must risk enough to make an answer possible.
A tiny offering may be caution, noise, or a hand testing whether your door has hinges.
Yet the ferryman feared every old betrayal and locked his chest.
Yet Doru, remembering older silences, refused to strike at all.
Ashamed, Doru carried five coals to the river.
He placed no seed on the current.

note: Wolf, Mira, ferryman, Doru each withhold from fair-record partners from old wounds; Thalea/Neris rebuke, shame, measured reform; numbered laws.
